# gravity_role_tftp (Resource)

Configuration of the TFTP role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gravity_role_tftp" "tftp" {
  port = 69
  # Also serve files from the instance's local filesystem
  enable_local = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enable_local` (Boolean) Serve files from the instance's local filesystem in addition to stored files. Defaults to `false`.
- `port` (Number) Defaults to `69`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Role configurations are singletons, identified by the role name
terraform import gravity_role_tftp.tftp 'tftp'
```
